disclaimer: SIMULATED procedures for the demo. Not NASA flight procedures. Follow actual mission procedures and Mission Control direction.

procedures.title: Conditions outside the evidence: confirm and report

steps.text: Confirm the O2 and pressure readings on a second display or sensor.
Open 'Why this?' and read which exposed materials have no NASA microgravity evidence at these conditions.
Consider delaying unpacking of fabrics without evidence here.
Consider stowing fabrics without evidence here.
Tell Mission Control the cabin is outside the tested range and which materials are affected.
Log the decision and the readings.
Confirm the O2 and pressure readings on a second display or sensor.
Review the limiting material and any fabrics flagged by the indicator.
Consider delaying unpacking of flagged fabrics.
Consider stowing flagged fabrics.
Ask Mission Control whether the O2 setpoint should be reviewed.
Open 'Why this?' and read which conditions are untested.
Log the decision and the readings.
Notify the commander and Mission Control.
Pause non-essential handling and unpacking of fabrics.
Stow exposed fabrics.
Ask Mission Control whether O2 should be returned to the design point under approved procedures.
Confirm the location of fire-response equipment as listed in the vehicle's approved procedures.
Watch the gauge until it leaves the critical band; log each reading.

procedures.title: Fire event: hand off to the approved procedure
procedures.trigger: manual only (detectors raise the alarm, not this tool)

steps.text: This tool does not provide fire-response steps. Follow the vehicle's approved fire emergency procedure and Mission Control direction.
After the event, log what was exposed and the cabin readings, for the evidence record.
